outcome: Duration of time to vaginal delivery
cohort: 467 primiparous women with poor cervical condition and delayed pregnancy (gestational age > 40 weeks)
finding: Obese primiparous women with an unfavorable cervix in delayed pregnancy had a significantly higher risk of cesarean section and a longer duration until vaginal delivery than non-obese primiparas during labor induction.
mod_finding: Obese primiparous women with an unfavorable cervix in delayed pregnancy had a significantly higher risk of cesarean section than non-obese primiparous women during labor induction.
